description: The file is a shell script that performs network connectivity checks, including ping tests and DNS resolution, with logic for resetting a router and performing corrective actions based on network test results.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current corrective action state from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay time for starting ping tests.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by invoking a system command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Performs a reset operation based on the process name.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs a DNS ping test if enabled, and triggers corrective action on failure.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs ICMP ping tests to the default gateway and triggers reset if packet loss is detected.
